native_semantics.phase_battle_clock: Phase scene types 2 and 3 do not enter CampaignProcess play state 7; non-stop-tick phase assets consume ordinary battle time. Ultra directly measured advancing both Spot and Campaign clocks with 122 squad fire callbacks during a 2.992-second phase.
native_semantics.phase_spot_tick: MonsterTimeLineControl.Play pauses SpotManagement only when MonsterCutSceneOption.isStopTick is true; only the excluded timeline control continues
native_semantics.phase_combat_control: BTContext.StopAllBT and MonsterContext.StopMove/StopFire cutscene handlers are guarded by scene type 4 (Dead), not phase types 2/3. Pending phase volleys remain scheduled; isPhaseAction waits for its timeline to finish.
